[SWS_DM_00130] Not supported addressAndLengthFormatIdentifier
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04120
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall send the negative response 0x31 (
kRe-
questOutOfRange
), if an addressAndLengthFormatIdentifier with a value outside the
range between 1 and 8 is received.
⌋
